---
name: New plugin request
about: Request (or propose) support for a tool dotmaster doesn't generate config for yet
labels: plugin, good first issue
---

**Tool / file(s) to generate**
e.g. Terraform (`main.tf`), pre-commit for a specific hook, `.nvmrc`, devcontainer.json

**What should trigger it?**
Which `dotmaster.yaml` fields should activate this plugin?

**Reference example**
Link to a well-regarded example of this config file, if you have one.

**Are you interested in implementing it?**
See [`docs/plugin-authoring.md`](../../docs/plugin-authoring.md) — most
plugins are 30–80 lines and a good first PR.
